source_name: Balkan Green Energy News — regional appointments coverage (EBRD/IFI people moves)
why_relevant: Despite the energy focus, it reliably reports IFI regional-director appointments (e.g. EBRD Western Balkans head) that determine financing counterparties and reorganisations touching Kosovo banks.

source_name: connectingregion.com (The Region) — Western Balkans institutional analysis
why_relevant: English-language regional outlet producing explainer/analysis pieces on why particular IFI and institutional appointments matter for Kosovo — an example of the translator/commentary layer this cell targets.

source_name: Finance Think — Economic Research and Policy Institute, Skopje
why_relevant: Named seed think tank; publishes labour-market and financial-sector studies for North Macedonia and occasionally the wider region. No Kosovo banking-people output was observed, so treat as a low-yield pointer to regional research networks.

source_name: Balkan Payment Forum (promoney-events) — regional payments conference programme
why_relevant: Conference agendas and speaker lists are a reliable, low-noise register of who currently holds which payments/banking role across the Balkans, including Kosovo institutions — effectively a published actor map refreshed yearly.

source_name: NLB Group Investor Relations (announcements & regulated disclosures)
why_relevant: NLB d.d. is the listed parent of NLB Banka sh.a. Prishtina (~82% stake). Management-board appointments, subsidiary reorganisations and group-level structural changes are disclosed here, usually in EN before any Albanian-language local pickup.

source_name: SEOnet — Ljubljana Stock Exchange regulated information portal (NLB issuer feed)
source_subtype: regulated information service / exchange disclosure portal
why_relevant: Statutory filing venue for NLB d.d. Management/supervisory board changes and group restructurings must be filed here, often earlier and in fuller legal detail than on the corporate site. Acts as a pointer to the underlying PDF releases.

source_name: NLB Banka sh.a. Prishtina — Management Board page
why_relevant: Roster page for the Kosovo unit; diffing it over time detects leadership changes even when neither group nor local media issues a release.

source_name: ProCredit Holding — press releases / ad-hoc news
why_relevant: Frankfurt-listed parent of ProCredit Bank Kosova. Confirmed to publish management-board appointments that directly involve the Kosovo unit (e.g. the 2023 release appointing Eriola Bibolli, then General Manager of ProCredit Bank Kosovo, to the group Management Board).

source_name: ProCredit Holding — Supervisory Board / governance pages
why_relevant: Group governance roster; changes here often precede or accompany subsidiary board reshuffles in Kosovo.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosova — Board of Directors / bank structure
why_relevant: Authoritative roster of the Kosovo unit's board and shareholders; the local mirror of group-level appointment news.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosova — Annual Report PDF series
why_relevant: Annual reports narrate organizational changes, headcount, staff-development spend and board composition for the Kosovo unit — the densest single artefact for A5 structural/HR intelligence.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank International — Media Hub / press releases
why_relevant: RBI is the Vienna-listed parent of Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo J.S.C. Group press releases cover management-board reorganisations and, periodically, network-bank CEO appointments and country reorganisations.

source_name: RBI — Leadership & Governance / Management Board roster
why_relevant: Group board roster and portfolio split; the CEE-network board seat determines who signs off Kosovo-unit structural changes.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo — Management Board & Board of Directors pages
why_relevant: Local roster for the RBI Kosovo unit (CEO and board of directors). Diffing detects appointments/departures; the BoD page reveals which RBI group executives sit over Kosovo.

source_name: EQS News — ad-hoc / DGAP regulated announcements (RBI, ProCredit Holding)
why_relevant: Distribution channel carrying the legally mandated ad-hoc releases of RBI and ProCredit Holding; searchable and machine-friendly, and often indexed before the issuers' own sites are recrawled.

source_name: Investegate — company announcement archive (NLB and other issuers)
why_relevant: Aggregates RNS/company announcements including NLB d.d. board appointments (NLB has GDRs/London-facing disclosure). Useful as a redundant, searchable archive when issuer sites reorganise URLs.

source_name: KAP — Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu (Turkish public disclosure platform)
why_relevant: Statutory disclosure venue for Türk Ekonomi Bankası (TEB, BNP Paribas/Çolakoğlu JV, parent of TEB Sh.A. Kosova) and other Turkish-listed financial groups. Board changes and subsidiary transactions are filed here in Turkish first.

source_name: Türk Ekonomi Bankası (TEB) — Yönetim Kurulu / Üst Yönetim and investor pages
source_subtype: parent corporate governance page + annual report
why_relevant: TEB is the Turkish parent brand behind TEB Sh.A. Kosova; its board/senior-management rosters and annual reports name the executives who sit on or supervise the Kosovo unit.

source_name: TEB Holding A.Ş. corporate site
why_relevant: The Çolakoğlu/BNP Paribas holding vehicle above TEB; ownership-level changes here propagate to the Kosovo unit's governance.

source_name: BNP Paribas Group — press releases / international retail banking
why_relevant: Ultimate co-owner of the TEB franchise; group communications occasionally cover TEB-network reorganisations and senior appointments relevant to the Kosovo unit.

source_name: Banka Kombëtare Tregtare (BKT Albania) — Bordi Drejtues / BKT Banking Group
source_subtype: parent governance page + group structure page
why_relevant: The Tirana parent inside Çalık Holding. Group-level leadership and 'BKT Banking Group' structure pages carry the appointments that flow down to BKT Kosova, in Albanian.

source_name: Çalık Holding — corporate news / financial services segment
why_relevant: Ultimate owner of the BKT franchise; holding-level communications occasionally announce banking-segment executive changes before BKT's own sites are updated.

source_name: Ziraat Bank Kosova — Üst Yönetim (senior management)
why_relevant: The Kosovo unit of Ziraat publishes its senior-management roster in TR/SQ/EN; it is the only primary record of appointments at this state-owned Turkish parent's Kosovo subsidiary.

source_name: T.C. Ziraat Bankası — Yönetim Kurulu / Üst Yönetim and press announcements
why_relevant: State-owned parent; changes at group level (general manager, board) cascade to the Kosovo subsidiary's board seats. Group annual reports enumerate foreign subsidiaries including Kosovo.

source_name: Anadolu Ajansı (AA) — Turkish state news agency, banking appointments desk
why_relevant: Reliable first reporter of Ziraat/state-bank general-manager and board appointments in Turkish, typically the same day as the official decision and ahead of subsidiary-site updates.

source_name: TheOfficialBoard / CB Insights — executive org-chart aggregators
why_relevant: Crowd/vendor-maintained org charts for NLB Banka Prishtina and Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo. Low authority and often stale, but occasionally surfaces mid-level structural roles absent from official pages; treat as lead-generation only.

source_name: BQK — Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara (PDF register)
why_relevant: Authoritative periodic PDF listing every licensed/registered financial institution in Kosovo, including non-bank financial institutions (IFJB), e-money institutions and payment institutions. This is the master actor-map generator for the payments-employer landscape: every PSP/EMI/MTO legal entity that can legally hire in Kosovo appears here, and diffs between successive editions reveal new market entrants (i.e. new employers) before any hiring news appears.
